summary: The note surveys mental health and well-being initiatives in schools, organized by approach: curriculum, calm spaces, peer support, arts and sports, apps, inclusive frameworks, parent forums and educator wellness. It gives named programs, schools, people and dates from 2023. It concludes that school mental health support is a lasting movement rather than a passing trend.
one_line: Overview of 2023 school mental health programs, from peer support and calm spaces to apps, parent forums and teacher wellness days.
key_facts: Principal Linda Harris launched the 'Mind Matters' program in Smalltown School District on September 15, 2023, to teach coping skills and provide a listening ear.
As of September 22, Westview High introduced a pilot curriculum with modules on emotional intelligence and stress management, crafted with input from students and mental health professionals.
Michael Johnson of Westview High is cited as an educator championing weekly student discussions that demystify mental health issues.
Brighton Elementary introduced the 'Serenity Corner' in early October 2023, stocked with resources for self-guided mindfulness and relaxation.
Hatfield High School started the Peer Supporter Program on October 10, 2023, where seniors trained in active listening hold open sessions during lunch breaks.
Jessica Lee, a senior and peer supporter, said "it’s all about being there, really there, for someone who might not have anyone else to turn to."
Riverdale Middle School revamped its after-school programs on November 1, 2023, offering activities from pottery to soccer; Coach Robert Ellis called them "therapeutic."
Every student at Oakwood High is given access to a suite of well-being apps starting from the first semester; counselor Sarah Gomez said they "put wellness right in the student's pocket."
The Citywide School District unveiled its Inclusive Mental Health Framework on December 5, 2023, addressing cultural backgrounds, orientations, and identities.
Monroe School has hosted monthly parent-teacher mental health forums since January 2023.
Since February 2023, several schools have introduced mandatory wellness days for teachers and ongoing professional support, after a survey showed educators face burnout and stress.
